name: Mexico City International Airport (Benito Juárez)

permits.v: closed to private general aviation and air taxi since a presidential decree of 1 June 1994; the DGAC circular CO SA-30/12 allows only exceptions (flights requested by the Presidency, federal ministers and other listed officials, diplomats at the Foreign Ministry's request), for aircraft over 5,700 kg; requests at least 5 hours ahead, Mon-Fri 09:00-16:00, subject to space in the daily schedule, and not in the peak periods 07:00-10:00 and 19:00-22:00; the decree excludes military, presidential staff, air ambulance, emergency and rotary-wing aircraft and those the ministry authorises
permits.quote: el cierre de las operaciones en el AICM a la aviación privada, la aviación de estado y las operaciones de taxi aéreo

ppr.v: any exceptional general aviation flight needs DGAC (now AFAC) authorisation requested at least 5 hours before the flight and depends on space in the AICM daily schedule; no flights 07:00-10:00 and 19:00-22:00
ppr.quote: entre las 07:00 a 10:00 horas y de las 19:00 a 22:00 horas

slots.v: AFAC declared AICM saturated (DOF 3 Mar 2022): Terminal 1 05:00-22:59, Terminal 2 06:00-19:59 and 21:00-22:59; a second resolution (DOF 31 Aug 2023) caps the airport at 43 take-offs and landings per hour from 8 Jan 2024; every operation needs an assigned slot
slots.quote: La primera declara la saturación el edificio terminal 1, de las 5:00 a las 22:59 horas

notes: Mexico AIP (aipmexico.seneam.gob.mx, AD 2 MMMX, AMDT AIRAC 02/26: https://aipmexico.seneam.gob.mx/AIP/doc/AD/AD_2/38_MMMX/AD_2-MMMX-2.pdf) refused by the site (robots), so no runway, customs or hours data. The circular CO SA-30/12 (DGAC/SCT, in force from 17 May 2012, indefinite) is hosted on gob.mx; whether AFAC has amended it since was not checked. The circular does not say whether its times are local; local is the natural reading. AICM site pages read gave no runway or GA data. Practical meaning: private charter jets normally cannot use MMMX; offer Toluca (MMTO) or other airports. 1 Nov 2026: added slots from the AICM operator's Informe de Gestión Gubernamental 2018-2024 (dated 17 Sep 2024; the 2023 resolution's 43/hour cap applies 'en tanto prevalezcan las condiciones de saturación'). AIP AD 2 MMMX (https://aipmexico.seneam.gob.mx/AIP/doc/AD/AD_2/38_MMMX/AD_2-MMMX-2.pdf) still could not be opened (fetch tool blocked). Runway lengths not in the AICM documents read. | 3 Nov 2026: AIP AD 2 MMMX (https://aipmexico.seneam.gob.mx/AIP/doc/AD/AD_2/38_MMMX/AD_2-MMMX-2.pdf) again refused (robots); the owner should download it. Anexo 4 RGCE 2026 (DOF 14 Jan 2026, https://www.sat.gob.mx/minisitio/NormatividadRMFyRGCE/documentos2026/rgce/anexos/Anexo4delasRGCEpara2026.pdf) gives Aduana AICM Mon-Fri 08:00-20:00, Sat 10:00-14:00, but only for import and export of goods; not recorded as customs, because it does not say it covers private flight clearance.
